instruction:
Reset Absolute Coordinates With Georeferencing

Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to modify /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc by resetting product geometry from absolute coordinates into local model space while preserving the georeferencing metadata. You may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Save the completed IFC4 model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. The final model must contain one project, one site, one building, and one storey named Ground Floor; four walls; one slab; one door; two windows; three openings; three void relationships; three fill relationships; one IfcProjectedCRS; and one IfcMapConversion. Do not include spaces, proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique.

Keep the product names South Wall, East Wall, North Wall, West Wall, Base Slab, Entry, Win E, and Win W. Their dimensions must be South and North Wall 12.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m, East and West Wall 0.20 m by 8.00 m by 3.00 m, Base Slab 12.00 m by 8.00 m by 0.25 m, Entry 0.244 m by 0.115 m by 1.083 m, and Win E and Win W each 0.119 m by 0.075 m by 0.119 m. Assign all walls, the slab, door, and windows to Ground Floor. Preserve the projected CRS name EPSG:3857 and the map conversion values Eastings 1000000.000, Northings 2000000.000, OrthogonalHeight 0.000, XAxisAbscissa 1.000, XAxisOrdinate 0.000, and Scale 1.000. Keep every generated product bounding-box coordinate within 200.00 m of the local origin. Other representation details may vary.
